title: GlowTrack
description: Track player movement with glowing 3D trajectory lines, timeline review, teleport, and Xaero map integration.
body:
## GlowTrack

Track whitelisted players with a glowing rainbow heat-mapped trajectory rendered in-world, review the timeline, teleport to any moment, and overlay paths on Xaero maps.

### Features
- 3 render modes: 3D line, 2D flat line, Xaero map overlay
- Rainbow speed-heat coloring, glow, wallhack, time labels, flowing pulse
- Timeline review with live readout + one-click teleport (cross-dimension)
- OP GUI with searchable whitelist list

### Dependencies
- **NeoForge** 1.21.1 (required)
- **Xaero's World Map / Minimap** (optional)

### Source
[GitHub](https://github.com/szkele1145/glowtrack)
